title: Importance of Friday Night Darood
summary: Emphasizes reading Darood on Friday for blessings.
translation: Tonight is the night of Friday, and on the night of Friday, one should abundantly recite Darood. Besides providing worldly and hereafter benefits, it is necessary to present Darood to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as a gesture of gratitude for his favors upon us. This act is such that Allah Himself joins in. All acts of worship are performed by us alone, but Allah and His angels also send blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and we are commanded to do so as well. Thus, make a special effort to recite Darood today because the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) stated that the best of your days is Friday. On this day, recite Darood abundantly because your Darood is conveyed to me. Another hadith mentions that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said to recite Darood abundantly on Friday and its night; whoever does so will receive my intercession on the Day of Judgment. Therefore, recite Darood as much as possible, at least three hundred times or more, as you wish—be it one lakh, two lakh, three thousand, four thousand, or any number. Involve your household, assign them the responsibility to complete these numbers so that blessings, mercy, safety, and peace descend upon your home. Send a gift from your household to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and an angel will convey your and your household’s names, along with your parents', to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), bringing him joy from the gift sent. On this basis, may Allah forgive us all.
